subject: Request for any retained copy of the 1994 Llandough / Great House Farm archaeological material
source: Original email in the family's Gmail (read-only export); contact details redacted.
text:
Dear Cotswold Archaeology,

A preservation notice has already been served. I request confirmation whether you hold any retained copy of the 1994 early-medieval cemetery excavation archive or report relating to the redevelopment of land formerly part of Great House Farm / Tŷ Mawr, Llandough-juxta-Penarth, and, if so, the terms on which a copy may be obtained.

Yours sincerely,
Sion Buckler (Ret'd Sergeant), Royal Signals Cyber/Electronic Warfare Professional and Life Member
